annotation: BioY family protein; Central protein that confers the ability to take up biotin on E.coli; while biotin transport requires BioM at very low (pM) concentrations at higher (nM) concentrations expression of BioY alone suffices for uptake.
Cobalt ABC transporter, permease protein CbiQ-3; Probably involved in biotin uptake, although complementation experiments in E.coli do not indicate a clear role.
Cobalt ABC transporter, ATP-binding protein CbiO-3; Required for biotin uptake under very low (pM) biotin concentrations but not under higher (nM) concentrations.
